title: Figure and image rules are per site
description:
Requested by Humorus (https://github.com/AnthusAI/Humorus), the satire publications that run a second, very different newsroom on Papyrus. Humorus issue: HUM-0cb875.

`data/figures/rules.md` is one file for every site. Each site's prompts are built only from its own rules. Humorus keeps the rule that no generated image shows a real person.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Merged in #1423. Decision: the image prompt skeleton was already built only from the site's own image profile (binding constraints, e.g. no real person). What was shared was data/figures/rules.md, so a site-rule kind 'figure-rules' (bodyMarkus, the complete text) now replaces it per site; papyrus figures rules prints the site's and says which.
